requirements.title: Accounts and login
requirements.summary: User accounts, passwords, email verification, password reset, and roles.

requirements.title: Account approval
requirements.summary: New accounts wait as pending; admins approve, reject, or suspend them.

requirements.title: Properties and units
requirements.summary: Staff create properties and units and link tenants through a lease; every property has a landlord.

requirements.title: Maintenance requests
requirements.summary: Tenants submit requests with a category and photos; staff work them through statuses; every change is recorded.

requirements.title: Property documents
requirements.summary: Staff upload documents to a property or unit; an admin decides who else can see each one.

requirements.title: Notifications
requirements.summary: Email and push notifications, and messaging. Deferred — nothing built yet.

requirements.title: Permissions
requirements.summary: Nothing is readable without logging in, and each role sees only its own slice of the data.

requirements.title: Admin web portal
requirements.summary: Dashboard, user management, rental applications, vendors and settings — limited to the right people.

workflows.title: Maintenance request lifecycle
workflows.summary: A tenant submits a request, an admin assigns it to a worker, the worker views and works the request, and the tenant sees the outcome.

workflows.title: New account onboarding
workflows.summary: A new resident signs up, verifies their email, waits for approval, and gets into the portal once an admin approves them.
